Findings.problem: The trusted insertion axiom promises an ID outside an arbitrary Set<u64>, without any restriction on that set. Choosing the full u64 set leaves no permitted result for an otherwise admissible empty-list insertion; the executable allocator only supplies freshness relative to its actual allocation history.
Findings.key_premise: used_ids has no precondition and can contain every u64, while the empty-owner branch requires a returned u64 outside it.
Findings.suggestion: Tie used_ids to an authoritative allocation history and model allocator exhaustion, or require and justify an available fresh ID before this proof-level state transition.

Findings.problem: ListStore defines its intrinsic validity as an inherent inv method instead of implementing the shared Inv trait.
Findings.key_premise: The whole target has no Inv implementation for ListStore.
Findings.suggestion: Move this unchanged predicate into impl<M: AnyFrameMeta + Repr<MetaSlotSmall>> Inv for ListStore<M>.

Compliance.compliance_or_na_reason: These are explicit crate-specific embedding axioms over OSTD owners, not opaque standard-library specifications. Their semantic gap is reported separately; no third-party wrapper is introduced.
No immutable external container model generalized over interior-mutable storage is introduced; owner relations explicitly constrain permissions. Full Repr boundary implementation unavailable.
Insertion and removal axioms retain position bounds; optional take operations branch on range membership.

Front/back helpers reuse the general transition and fresh IDs reuse lemma_finite_int_set_has_unused. Searched available ostd roots; vendored vstd and verified_libs absent, upstream prohibited, so absence of duplicates is not established.
Maps track ownership pools and existing sequence-plus-position CursorOwner models track order.
Relational membership properties use explicit slot and map-membership triggers; not simple unary sequence predicates.
